sources.title: Open-source AI Models for Any Application | Llama 3
sources.snippet: Llama 3 models Llama includes multilingual text-only models (1B, 3B), including quantized versions, text-image models (11B, 90B) and Llama 3.3 70B model offering similar performance to the Llama 3.1 405B model, allowing developers to achieve greater quality and performance on text-based applications at a fraction of the cost.

sources.title: All Meta Llama Models - Open Source LLMs (2026)
sources.snippet: The complete Meta Llama model lineup: 8 open-source models spanning from compact 1B-parameter variants to the flagship Llama 4 Maverick. Meta's Llama family is the most widely adopted open-source LLM ecosystem, offering free weights for self-hosting, fine-tuning, and commercial use. Scores updated hourly from live API data.

sources.title: Llama (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Llama[a] (" Large Language Model Meta AI " serving as a backronym) was a family of large language models (LLMs) released by Meta AI from February 2023 to April 2025. [3] Llama models come in different sizes, ranging from 1 billion to 2 trillion parameters. Initially only a foundation model, [4] starting with Llama 2, Meta AI released instruction fine-tuned versions alongside foundation models ...
